events.text:
I logged what the backend does with a workshop payment, renamed the old "Build Pass" wording in the app and pushed it. T-070 stays on hold, as the Orchestrator asked.

**Completion check:**
- **What the handler does with pdt_0NnpA6EIxXvDvS1F03N8Z (read-only):** Done, logged on T-070. I read the local tantra-backend-v2 checkout (commit f0b901e) and changed nothing in it. A workshop payment arrives as a one-time `payment.*` event. `onPayment()` (lines 102 to 108) stores a payment row and answers 200.
  - It is "unmatched" unless the buyer already has a Tantra billing account. `ownerFor()` matches only an existing account's subscription id, Dodo customer id, or `metadata.userId`. It never matches by email, which corrects the Orchestrator's note.
  - Matched or not, it grants no plan, because only `subscription.*` events reach `applySubscription`.
  - Stripe payments (T-218) never reach this handler.
- **Integration plan:** Done, logged. The plan is granted from the centre's attendee list (T-122) by calling the backend's existing `BillingTrialCampaignService.grant` (`billing-trial-campaign.service.ts:320`).
- **Pro Course note (ripple from T-071):** Done, logged. The $999 course gets the same treatment, so the team keeps emailing access by hand.
- **Question for Bharath:** Asked in the log. They need to confirm production runs this same processor code.
- **"Build Pass" renames:** Done. "$99 seat / VIP" is now in `app/src/app/api/checkout/route.ts:5`. In `app/src/app/api/dodo/webhook/route.ts`, the wording was on the log line at :116, not :83, so I changed it there. tsc ran clean, and commit dab1571b is on origin/main.
  - I left the event name `build_pass_paid` (line 100) as it is. It is the event name sent to the fulfilment URL, which is not set, so nothing reads it yet.
- **Push side effect:** A shell quoting slip in my first commit command meant the commit failed but `git push origin main` still ran. That pushed 8 commits from other lanes (T-040, T-005, T-129, T-290, T-285, T-289, T-276) before mine. Main was 8 commits ahead and 0 behind origin, so nothing was overwritten.
- **Test purchase gives the promised plan on a test account:** Not done. It waits for Adi's integration hold and the T-005 key rotation.
- **Status:** T-070 is set to hold, and notes F-f5b965db and R-bddc03fc are acked.
